purpose: Exploratory author-train stress test of unseen speakers and canonical /R/ target words
outerPurge: Hold out all clips of the assigned speakers; remove from outer fit every clip whose exact canonical /R/ target word occurs in the heldout clips
innerAssignment: Select inner validation speakers from retained outer fit speakers with the existing seeded hash rule
innerPurge: Within retained outer fit, remove from inner fit every clip whose exact canonical /R/ target word occurs in inner validation clips
label: Five individual rater scores per clip represented as a three-class empirical distribution
head: Linear softmax on fit-standardized frozen full-clip pooled features with L2 weight penalty and unpenalized intercept
selectionMetric: Inner speaker-and-word-disjoint per-rater natural-log loss; lowest candidate breaks ties
baseline: Fit-only three-class prior with one pseudocount per class
optimizer: Torch CPU float64 LBFGS strong_wolfe, zero initialization, max 400 iterations, history 10
brierDefinition: Mean across all five raters of the sum of squared probability errors over three one-hot classes
